sentences.en: I felt utterly out of place among those sophisticated people.

sentences.en: It aims to furnish factories and homes with sophisticated robots.
sentences.zh: 它的目标是为工厂和家庭提供先进的机器人。

sentences.en: You think I'm not as sophisticated as you, don't you?
sentences.zh: 你认为我不如你那么有教养，对吧？
